name: tab_ext
description: ブラウザをまたいだタブ共有を行う拡張機能

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run clean:chrome && vite build --mode chrome && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run clean:firefox && vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs firefox && npm run build:xpi
scripts.build:xpi: rimraf dist/firefox-artifacts && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/firefox-artifacts
